experiment.unit: one before_agent_start invocation with at least one parsed memory and known repository cwd
experiment.control: run the existing memory filter in shadow mode; do not prune the system prompt
experiment.treatment: run the existing memory filter and apply validated drops
experiment.assignment: independent Bernoulli per eligible invocation; treatment probability 0.90, control probability 0.10
experiment.eligibility: only when the explicit event-randomization switch is enabled; disabled by default; no switch creation or live enablement in this bead
experiment.logging: one hash-only assignment row per eligible invocation with event_id, chosen arm, chosen-arm propensity, and both arm probabilities; no prompt or memory text

offline_simulation.source: the qpv2 4-hour block schedule and completed flip journal, joined to local memory-filter shadow decision rows by timestamp
offline_simulation.unit: promptHash and instance grouped within a 60-second timestamp window; ambiguous or incomplete groups excluded and counted
offline_simulation.outcome: sum of logged tokensSaved for candidate filter drops; control potential outcome is zero
offline_simulation.interpretation: mechanistic token-saving proxy only; not task success, memory utility, or evidence of safe pruning
offline_simulation.estimand: finite-sample average treatment effect on the registered token-saving proxy
offline_simulation.comparison: 10,000 seeded assignment replays on the same eligible events: per-event 90/10 Bernoulli assignment versus 4-hour block assignment following the qpv2 block size and 50/50 arm share; report empirical estimator variance and ratio without a pass threshold or direction claim
offline_simulation.estimators: report inverse-propensity (Horvitz-Thompson) and doubly-robust estimates; doubly-robust outcome predictions are cross-fitted by 4-hour block; confidence intervals use the estimator's empirical influence-function standard error
offline_simulation.planted_effect: add a fixed +100 proxy tokens to every treated potential outcome; require the planted-effect estimate's 95% interval to contain +100 in the fixed-seed replay
